༄༅/ /rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi tshogs dmigs zin bris bzhugs/lags/nyid kyi tshogs mchod skor gyi dmigs pa mdor bsdus dgos gsungs pa/rnying ma bka'

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi tshogs dmigs zin bris bzhugs/ lags/ nyid kyi tshogs mchod skor gyi dmigs pa mdor bsdus dgos gsungs pa/ rnying ma bka' gter rgyud lung man ngag rnams su tshogs kyi rnam bzhag rgya cher 'byung ba dang*/ rang lugs rje btsun grags pa/ chos rje sa paṇa/ ngor chen bcas kyi tshogs 'khor rnam bzhag zhib mo yod pa rnams cung zad tsam re las don gyi gnad gcig pa dang*/ /rnying phyogs la skal ldan lha'i tshogs/ dgyes ldan mi'i tshogs/ 'byor ldan yo byad kyi tshogs so/ /dang po ni dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang*/ gnyis pa ni rnal 'byor dam ldan mched lcam dang*/ gsum pa ni rten mchod sgrub rdzas dang*/ /khyad par du tshogs kyi yo byad rnams yin la/ de yang rtsa gsum dril sgrub lta bu la mtshon na/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams las bza' ba g.yas dang*/ btung ba g.yon du gcan gzan gyi pags pa bkram pa'i khar bshams/ phyag len phal cher la me chu rlung gsum gyi sbyang ba byed kyang*/ smin gling phyag len du bsang chu'am/ las bum bsgrubs yod na de dang*/ med na chu gtsang dang nang mchod kyi bdud rtsi bran par mdzad cing*/ ram̐ gyis me 'bar bas mi gtsang ba'i dri ma bsregs/ yam̐ las rlung byung bas gtor/ kham̐ las chu byung bas dri ma sbyong*/ /tshogs kyi snod stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i ka pā la'am/

gzhung 'di'i dngos bstan thod snod yin/ rin po che'i yol go pad+mas mtshan pa rgya khyon tshad las 'das pa'i nang du tshogs gtor rin po che sna tshogs kyi lhun po rgya dang tshad dpag tu med pa dang*/ rdzas rnams sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i ngo bo de dang de yin pa la rnam pa 'dod yon drug gi lha mo kun tu bzang po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam 'phrul ltar spro ba dang*/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gsal ba'i thugs nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum char babs pa ltar 'phros pas oṃ gyis ma dag pa sbyangs/ āḥyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir spel/ hūm̐ gis gang mos su sgyur/ ha ho hrīḥs rgya cher spel zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshogs gtor de rim pa gsum du spros la/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can 'phros pas nam mkha'i khams gang ba'i tshogs zhing rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams spyan drangs/ tshogs gtor gyi steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs par sgom pa'am/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor bsgoms yod na de la dbyer med du thim par bsam la/ tshogs phud dang po dang bdud rtsi'i phud kyi zeg ma las phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dpag med sprau bas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mchoXd pa dang*/ bar pas dam tshig nyams chag thams cad skong zhing bshaXgs pa dang*/ tha mas bstan la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs dam sri kla klo sogs kyi rnam shes dgug bstim dang*/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las gur drag dang rta mgrin sogs khro bo dang*/ khro mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas mtshon cha'i char phab ste gzugs phung bsgralaX zhing*/ rnam shes dbyings su bstims shing lnga phung zhal du bstabs pa'i dmigs pa mdor bsdus bya dgos shing*/ de ltar phul bas mchog thun gyi dngos grub zhu stsol gyi gsol 'debs te/ 'di'i 'don cha shin tu bsdus pa yin kyang tshig nyung don rgyas pa dang*/

skong bshags ni gong gi tshogs bar pa las 'phros pa yin pas tshogs gtor gyi rdzas rnams las gzhung tshig dang mthun pa'i mchod sprin spro ba dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi rdo rje'i dbang po drug gis dgyes rgur rol zhing tshims pas thugs rgyud la bde chen dga' bzhi'i ye shes kyi ros gang zhing*/ bdag cag rnal 'byor pa'i dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs rnams byang zhing dag nas rtsa gsum rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i gsang gsum byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs pa dang*/ tshogs zh-ing rnams kyi gnas gsum las 'od zer byung ba rang gi gnas gsum phog pa sogs dbang blang ba'i dmigs pa gzhung gsal ltar dang*/ tshogs la rol ba'i skabs bdag lus phung khams skye mched gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha la tshogs rdzas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi mchod par mos shing*/ spro na rdo rje'i glu blang ba sogs bya/ lhag ma la dam tshig dang ldan pa rnams kyis bza' ba'i lhag ma dang*/ dkyil 'khor pa la mchod pa'i lhag ma rnams gcig tu bsres/ slob dpon gyi zhal chab dang sman rag gis bran la/ dpal chen po'i pha 'bab la dbang ba'i/ dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ ma tshogs 'bar ma ging dang laṅka ste srin po la sogs lhag mgron rnams la 'bul zhing stob pas bar chad sel zhing rnam bzhi'i phrin las bsgrub par bsam/ mthar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gcig tu tshogs pa rnams tshom bu gcig tu mngon 'tshang rgya ba'i smon lam gdab pa ste go don mdor bsdus dang*/ de dag gi skabs su lha yi gsal snang dang mi 'bral ba dang*/ gtsang sme gnyis 'dzin mi bya zhing*/ shags dang ku co rtsod pa sogs mi bya ba'i tshogs kyi dam tshig rnams gsar rnying gi gsang ba spyi khyab ltar lags/ spyir rnal 'byor bla med kyi mchod pa thams cad kyi rgyal po tshogs 'khor 'di las phan yon che ba med par rgyud sde chen po rnams las yang yang bstan cing*/

de la deng dus rang re ma dag pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur pas za 'dod gyi sred pa sogs 'byung shas che yang*/ de 'dra'i rang 'dod kyi 'phri ba de ni lha sgom sngags bzlas tshogs bsags mchod pa sogs gang gi skabs su yang rang don yid byed kyi blo ngan dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i dug dang 'dres pa re 'byung 'dug pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa yin na bza' btung tshogs 'khor du shes dgos pa yin kyang*/ de'ang zhim btsog gi sred pa dang bcas bza' ba'i phyir na/ za 'dod tshogs 'khor bskor ba'i rnying ma pa/ zhes zer yang brjod 'dod tsam las/ don la nyes ltung bskyed pa mtshungs pa'i phyir/ des na kun slong bcos pa dang*/ dran shes bag yod kyi bsam pa brtan po byed pa shin tu gces so/ zhes pa'ang nub bla mas gsung bskul ngor chos kyi blo gros pas so// //
